title: Vapouriz Premium Bubblegum 10ml E-Liquid
description: The classic, fruity rush of bubblegum is a flavour that pops over your tastebuds, with deliciously sweet and sunny fruit candy notes that will make your mouth water as it puts a smile on your face. Vapouriz E-Liquids are expertly-crafted by Vapouriz Labs UK to deliver intense flavour and stunning vapour production for your e-cigarette setup. Browse the full collection of Vapouriz Premium E-Liquids and pick up the perfect pairing for any Vape Kit , Vape Starter Kits or Compact Pod Vape Kit . We’ve got a selection of formulations to suit all styles of e-cigarette devices, including High-PG blends for classic vaping as well as Vapouriz Nicotine Salts and adaptable 50:50 Vape Juice options.
